name: Clariane
summary: Clariane SE, established in Paris, France, in 2001 and known as Korian until its rebranding in June 2023, specializes in delivering comprehensive medical and non-medical care and support. The company serves senior citizens and individuals facing either temporary or chronic health challenges through a diverse range of provisions. These offerings encompass residential facilities like long-term nursing homes, specialized medical clinics, and senior living communities, including assisted living and co-housing arrangements. Furthermore, Clariane extends its services to include in-home care, various support programs, and hospitalization. Its operational footprint spans multiple European nations, including France, Germany, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, Belgium, and the United Kingdom.
